final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.record_count) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(t.record_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE t.record_count > a.avg_count
